ROUND_GO.speaker: B
ROUND_GO.text: Round {{round}} is on. Reminder: type a champion name plus a team tag and you are in the arena!

ROUND_GO.speaker: B
ROUND_GO.text: Bao, easy on the mic. But yes, get in there, {{boss}} will not die on its own!

ROUND_GO.speaker: A
ROUND_GO.text: Let us go! Round {{round}}, no losing this one!

ROUND_GO.speaker: B
ROUND_GO.text: Stay calm and hit it. Hearts, chat, gifts, every one of them is damage.

BOSS_ENRAGE.speaker: B
BOSS_ENRAGE.text: Enraged means it attacks half again as fast. Tap hearts to heal, do not let champions drop!

BOSS_ENRAGE.speaker: A
BOSS_ENRAGE.text: Oh my, {{boss}} changed form! It got stronger!

BOSS_ENRAGE.speaker: B
BOSS_ENRAGE.text: The wilder it gets, the easier the steal. Pour in the damage, the finish is close!

BOSS_ENRAGE.speaker: B
BOSS_ENRAGE.text: Honestly Bao is more furious than the boss. Ignore him, everyone, focus on the fight!

BOSS_PHASE_TWO.speaker: B
BOSS_PHASE_TWO.text: From now on it can wipe the whole arena. When it winds up, get ready to summon again!

BOSS_PHASE_TWO.speaker: A
BOSS_PHASE_TWO.text: Phase two! Things get serious now!

BOSS_PHASE_TWO.speaker: B
BOSS_PHASE_TWO.text: Serious how? The boss opens its ultimate, and we open our wallets… I mean the chat!

BOSS_PHASE_TWO.speaker: B
BOSS_PHASE_TWO.text: Good news: it already lost a third of its health. Bad news: it starts hitting for real.

BOSS_PHASE_THREE.speaker: A
BOSS_PHASE_THREE.text: FINAL PHASE! {{boss}} casts faster and hits harder!

BOSS_PHASE_THREE.speaker: B
BOSS_PHASE_THREE.text: Its damage is up twenty percent. But it only has a third of its health left, push!

BOSS_PHASE_THREE.speaker: A
BOSS_PHASE_THREE.text: It has lost it! Phase three!

BOSS_PHASE_THREE.speaker: B
BOSS_PHASE_THREE.text: This is where the big spenders step in. A gift right now is worth double the hype.

BOSS_PHASE_THREE.speaker: A
BOSS_PHASE_THREE.text: The apocalypse phase! {{boss}} goes all in!

BOSS_PHASE_THREE.speaker: B
BOSS_PHASE_THREE.text: Then so do we. Hearts, chat, gifts, everything at once!

BOSS_SHIELD_UP.speaker: A
BOSS_SHIELD_UP.text: {{boss}} raised a shield! Break it now!

BOSS_SHIELD_UP.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_UP.text: You have exactly {{seconds}} seconds. Miss it and the boss heals, all that work gone!

BOSS_SHIELD_UP.speaker: A
BOSS_SHIELD_UP.text: Energy shield! Hit it, hit it!

BOSS_SHIELD_UP.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_UP.text: Hit the right spot, Bao. Everyone, all damage on the shield for {{seconds}} seconds!

BOSS_SHIELD_UP.speaker: A
BOSS_SHIELD_UP.text: It is hiding behind a shield!

BOSS_SHIELD_UP.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_UP.text: How brave. Break it and the boss is stunned, then the hits feel great.

BOSS_SHIELD_BROKEN.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_BROKEN.text: Plus {{dmg}} bonus damage. Lovely! While it is stunned, hit twice as hard!

BOSS_SHIELD_BROKEN.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_BROKEN.text: Textbook. A broken shield costs {{boss}} another {{dmg}} health. No boss survives teamwork like that.

BOSS_SHIELD_BROKEN.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_BROKEN.text: Flimsy because you all hit thick, Bao. Keep this rhythm!

BOSS_SHIELD_ABSORBED.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_ABSORBED.text: Plus {{hp}} health for the boss. Next shield, all-out attack at once, do not let it run out.

BOSS_SHIELD_ABSORBED.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_ABSORBED.text: No regrets. Lesson learned: shield up means hearts and chat up too.

BOSS_SHIELD_ABSORBED.speaker: B
BOSS_SHIELD_ABSORBED.text: Not for long. It healed {{hp}}, hit it again and that is gone.

BOSS_LOW_HP.speaker: A
BOSS_LOW_HP.text: ALMOST THERE! Who takes the kill?!

BOSS_LOW_HP.speaker: B
BOSS_LOW_HP.text: The final blow gets honored right on screen. A gift now seals it, nobody can contest.

BOSS_LOW_HP.speaker: B
BOSS_LOW_HP.text: You count it down, Bao, I will watch who lands the last hit.

BOSS_LOW_HP.speaker: B
BOSS_LOW_HP.text: Nearly, not done. Do not just watch, type a champion name!

BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.speaker: B
BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.text: The most valuable moment of the round. Want your name on the board? Strike now!

BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.speaker: A
BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.text: {{hpPercent}} percent left! My heart is racing!

BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.speaker: B
BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.text: Yours or the viewers? Both should race right now, tap those hearts!

BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.speaker: B
BOSS_CRITICAL_TENSION.text: Last breath, not dead. One more push and it is over, both teams go!

COMEBACK.speaker: B
COMEBACK.text: Told you this was not over. {{teamOther}} fans, take it back!

COMEBACK.speaker: B
COMEBACK.text: Very believable. {{teamOther}} slacked for a moment and paid for it. Now they prove themselves.

COMEBACK.speaker: B
COMEBACK.text: And {{teamOther}} has not given up. This one flips a few more times, I would bet on it.

COMEBACK_BUFF.speaker: A
COMEBACK_BUFF.text: {{team}} gets the Comeback buff! Fifteen percent more damage!

COMEBACK_BUFF.speaker: B
COMEBACK_BUFF.text: Behind and buffed, what excuse is left? {{team}} fans, send in champions now!

COMEBACK_BUFF.speaker: B
COMEBACK_BUFF.text: The system is rooting for you. Use it, or it goes to waste.

COMEBACK_BUFF.speaker: A
COMEBACK_BUFF.text: {{team}} is fifteen percent stronger from now on!

COMEBACK_BUFF.speaker: B
COMEBACK_BUFF.text: Fifteen sounds small, but times a hundred champions it is a different story. Go!

TIGHT_RACE.speaker: A
TIGHT_RACE.text: NECK AND NECK! {{teamA}} and {{teamB}} trading blow for blow!

TIGHT_RACE.speaker: B
TIGHT_RACE.text: Under five percent apart. One gift right now flips the whole race.

TIGHT_RACE.speaker: B
TIGHT_RACE.text: I know, no need to yell in my ear. Fans of both teams, time to prove who wants it more!

TIGHT_RACE.speaker: B
TIGHT_RACE.text: That is the fun part. Do not just watch, a single champion changes the result.

DOMINANT_LEAD.speaker: B
DOMINANT_LEAD.text: {{teamOther}} fans, where are you? There is time, one summon wave pulls it back.

DOMINANT_LEAD.speaker: B
DOMINANT_LEAD.text: One-sided because the other side went quiet. {{teamOther}}, show me you are still here!

DOMINANT_LEAD.speaker: B
DOMINANT_LEAD.text: A {{leadPercent}} percent lead is big, but I have seen comebacks from further. Do not celebrate yet.

GIFT_BIG.speaker: B
GIFT_BIG.text: Thank you, {{name}}! {{team}} is in tears, and the boss is losing blood.

GIFT_BIG.speaker: B
GIFT_BIG.text: As it should. {{name}}, {{team}} owes you a round!

GIFT_BIG.speaker: B
GIFT_BIG.text: With people like {{name}}, {{team}} has nothing to fear. Thank you so much!

GIFT_MEGA.speaker: B
GIFT_MEGA.text: The whole arena held its breath. {{name}}, {{team}} will remember that name!

GIFT_MEGA.speaker: B
GIFT_MEGA.text: Bao speechless is a rare thing. Thank you {{name}}, you just rewrote this round for {{team}}!

GIFT_MEGA.speaker: B
GIFT_MEGA.text: The boss is stunned, and so am I. {{name}}, {{team}} bows to you!

ROUND_WIN.speaker: B
ROUND_WIN.text: Deserved. {{team}} dealt more damage, simple as that. But the series is not over.

ROUND_WIN.speaker: A
ROUND_WIN.text: Right, the next round gets even hotter!

ROUND_WIN.speaker: B
ROUND_WIN.text: {{team}} fans, celebrate. Other side, breathe. The next round is your payback.

ROUND_WIN.speaker: B
ROUND_WIN.text: Series {{score}}. Noted. Let us see if anyone gets revenge.

PODIUM_THANKS.speaker: B
PODIUM_THANKS.text: Those three carried the arena. Thank you, keep that form next round!

PODIUM_THANKS.speaker: B
PODIUM_THANKS.text: Want your name read out like that? You know what to do next round.

PODIUM_THANKS.speaker: B
PODIUM_THANKS.text: Look at that podium. Next round, that spot could be yours.

SERIES_WIN.speaker: B
SERIES_WIN.text: A series well earned. Congratulations {{team}}, and thank you to both sides for going all in.

SERIES_WIN.speaker: A
SERIES_WIN.text: Stay with us, the next matchup is coming!

SERIES_WIN.speaker: B
SERIES_WIN.text: Score {{score}}, nothing to argue. I feel for the losing side, but that is competition.

SERIES_WIN.speaker: B
SERIES_WIN.text: {{team}} fans, this moment is yours. Take a screenshot!

HEART_MILESTONE.speaker: A
HEART_MILESTONE.text: {{count}} hearts! {{heal}} health restored to the whole field!

HEART_MILESTONE.speaker: B
HEART_MILESTONE.text: See, hearts are not just pretty. Keep tapping, the next milestone comes sooner!

HEART_MILESTONE.speaker: A
HEART_MILESTONE.text: {{count}} hearts! The whole field is healthy again!

HEART_MILESTONE.speaker: B
HEART_MILESTONE.text: Your thumbs are healing potions. Do not stop.

HEART_MILESTONE.speaker: B
HEART_MILESTONE.text: {{heal}} health for every champion. The cheapest and best way to help, keep tapping!

BANTER_GUIDE.speaker: B
BANTER_GUIDE.text: For anyone new: type a champion name plus a team tag, for example {{champion}} {{teamB}}.

BANTER_GUIDE.speaker: A
BANTER_GUIDE.text: And the champion steps onto the field! Easy, right? Try it now!

BANTER_GUIDE.speaker: A
BANTER_GUIDE.text: Anna, explain the rules for the newcomers.

BANTER_GUIDE.speaker: B
BANTER_GUIDE.text: Sure. Chat {{champion}} {{teamA}} for a {{teamA}} champion, {{champion}} {{teamB}} for {{teamB}}. That is it.

BANTER_GUIDE.speaker: B
BANTER_GUIDE.text: Someone asked how to play. One chat line: champion name, space, team tag.

BANTER_GUIDE.speaker: A
BANTER_GUIDE.text: For example {{champion}} {{teamA}}! And you are fighting the boss with everyone!

BANTER_CTA.speaker: A
BANTER_CTA.text: Follow for a free champion, share and the boss takes a hit!

BANTER_CTA.speaker: B
BANTER_CTA.text: You sound like a commercial. But it is true, so go ahead, everyone.

BANTER_CTA.speaker: B
BANTER_CTA.text: Quick reminder: rapid hearts make champions attack faster and build Fury faster.

BANTER_CTA.speaker: A
BANTER_CTA.text: And every two hundred hearts heals the whole field! Tap, tap, tap!

BANTER_CTA.speaker: A
BANTER_CTA.text: Anyone not following yet? Raise your hand!

BANTER_CTA.speaker: B
BANTER_CTA.text: How would you see a hand. Press follow, the system sees it, the champion appears.

BANTER_HYPE.speaker: A
BANTER_HYPE.text: The energy is through the roof! Both sides all in!

BANTER_HYPE.speaker: B
BANTER_HYPE.text: I like this pace. Nobody backs off, the boss takes the beating.

BANTER_HYPE.speaker: B
BANTER_HYPE.text: With a field this full, every hit counts, Bao.

BANTER_HYPE.speaker: A
BANTER_HYPE.text: Exactly! Keep this rhythm and the boss cannot hold!

BANTER_HYPE.speaker: B
BANTER_HYPE.text: Keep that fire until the end of the round. The final minute is what decides it.

BANTER_BOSS_HP.speaker: B
BANTER_BOSS_HP.text: That is {{hpPercent}} percent of chances left to get on the board. Be quick.

BANTER_BOSS_HP.speaker: B
BANTER_BOSS_HP.text: {{boss}} at {{hpPercent}} percent. Bao, who takes the kill?

BANTER_BOSS_HP.speaker: A
BANTER_BOSS_HP.text: My guess: whoever is reading this line! Type a champion name!

BANTER_BOSS_HP.speaker: B
BANTER_BOSS_HP.text: Slipping slowly? Then we push it faster. Hearts, chat, gifts, let us go.

BANTER_FIELD.speaker: B
BANTER_FIELD.text: A crowd only works when everyone hits. No champion yet? Join and fill the ranks.

BANTER_FIELD.speaker: B
BANTER_FIELD.text: I count {{fieldCount}} champions on the field. {{boss}} is running out of air.

BANTER_FIELD.speaker: A
BANTER_FIELD.text: Take all its air! More champions, now!

BANTER_FIELD.speaker: A
BANTER_FIELD.text: Look at that field, Anna, {{fieldCount}} champions!

BANTER_FIELD.speaker: B
BANTER_FIELD.text: I see it. Nice, but I want that number doubled.

BANTER_LEAD.speaker: A
BANTER_LEAD.text: {{team}} leads the damage race! Where are the {{teamOther}} fans?

BANTER_LEAD.speaker: B
BANTER_LEAD.text: A lead means nothing yet. {{teamOther}} needs one wave of champions to pull it back.

BANTER_LEAD.speaker: B
BANTER_LEAD.text: {{team}} is slightly ahead. Any answer from {{teamOther}}?

BANTER_LEAD.speaker: A
BANTER_LEAD.text: There has to be! Chat a champion name plus {{teamOther}} right now!

BANTER_LEAD.speaker: B
BANTER_LEAD.text: For how long, we will see. I can feel {{teamOther}} starting to stir.

BANTER_SERIES.speaker: A
BANTER_SERIES.text: Series score {{score}}! Round {{round}} matters a lot!

BANTER_SERIES.speaker: B
BANTER_SERIES.text: It is a {{format}}, every round matters. But this one really is tighter.

BANTER_SERIES.speaker: B
BANTER_SERIES.text: It is {{score}}. Bao, which way does round {{round}} lean?

BANTER_SERIES.speaker: A
BANTER_SERIES.text: Toward whichever team chats more! Simple as that!

BANTER_SERIES.speaker: B
BANTER_SERIES.text: Win this and you hold the momentum. Cheer your team, do not just watch.

BANTER_IDLE.speaker: A
BANTER_IDLE.text: {{boss}} is waiting for a challenger! Who strikes first?

BANTER_IDLE.speaker: B
BANTER_IDLE.text: This silence worries me a little. {{teamA}}, {{teamB}}, anyone out there?

BANTER_IDLE.speaker: B
BANTER_IDLE.text: Empty field, bored boss, and Bao is about to fall asleep.

BANTER_IDLE.speaker: A
BANTER_IDLE.text: Who is asleep! I am waiting for you to type a champion name!

BANTER_IDLE.speaker: A
BANTER_IDLE.text: Way too quiet, this is not an arena!

BANTER_IDLE.speaker: B
BANTER_IDLE.text: Then make some noise. One chat line and {{boss}} will know you are here.

BANTER_EMPTY.speaker: A
BANTER_EMPTY.text: The field is empty! {{boss}} is laughing!

BANTER_EMPTY.speaker: B
BANTER_EMPTY.text: Let it laugh. Chat {{champion}} {{teamA}} or {{champion}} {{teamB}}, a champion appears and the laughing stops.

BANTER_EMPTY.speaker: B
BANTER_EMPTY.text: No champion on the field. I will count three seconds, three, two…

BANTER_EMPTY.speaker: A
BANTER_EMPTY.text: One! Chat a champion name plus {{teamA}} or {{teamB}} now!

BANTER_EMPTY.speaker: B
BANTER_EMPTY.text: Make it sadder. One champion each and the field is full again.

BANTER_PROVOCATION.speaker: A
BANTER_PROVOCATION.text: {{teamTrailing}} fans, where are you? Letting {{teamLeading}} take {{boss}} this easily?

BANTER_PROVOCATION.speaker: B
BANTER_PROVOCATION.text: Bao is pushing it. But {{teamTrailing}} fans, {{starTrailing}} really needs you right now.

BANTER_PROVOCATION.speaker: A
BANTER_PROVOCATION.text: {{teamLeading}} owns the field! Did {{teamTrailing}} give up?

BANTER_PROVOCATION.speaker: B
BANTER_PROVOCATION.text: No way. I think {{teamTrailing}} fans are just reloading. Prove me right!

BANTER_PROVOCATION.speaker: B
BANTER_PROVOCATION.text: I am backing {{teamTrailing}} here. One wave of champions and they are right back in it.

BANTER_PROVOCATION.speaker: A
BANTER_PROVOCATION.text: Then chat already! Champion name plus {{teamTrailing}}, show me!

SUMMON: {{name}} sends {{champion}} straight into the arena for {{team}}!
What a pick! {{name}} calls {{champion}} to battle, {{team}} grows stronger!
One more relentless warrior for {{team}}: {{name}} with {{champion}}!
PRO_SIGNATURE_DEPLOY: OH MY GOODNESS! {{name}} just deployed {{proPlayer}}'s signature champion {{champion}} for {{team}}!
The iconic {{champion}} of {{proPlayer}} enters the arena thanks to {{name}}!
Signature pick deployed! {{champion}} under {{team}} banner, true {{proPlayer}} style!
Masterstroke! {{name}} picked the legendary {{champion}} for {{proPlayer}}! The arena goes wild!
Ultimate firepower! {{name}} calls in {{proPlayer}}'s {{champion}} to crush the enemy!
SUMMON_WAVE: {{count}} new champions for {{team}}, the arena heats up!
{{team}} fans speak up: {{count}} champions at once!
FOLLOW: Thanks for the follow, {{name}}! Free {{champion}} for {{team}}!
